paragraphs: Mentioned in Chullin 66a and Menachot 79b: “Matityah ben Yehudah recited a teaching.”
Yuchasin records that he was Shmuel's student, but Hyman observes that no source is given there for this.[^1]

notes.text: סו./עט: give Chullin 66a/Menachot 79b by convention without new checks. תני with the named subject is recited a teaching, not a personal title or passive unnamed formula; no actual teaching content is supplied. Yuchasin is a short work title without verified author/edition; Shmuel is unqualified. ואין שם preserves there, naturally the cited work/context, with its antecedent compressed; machine שום and old source-at-all interpretation are not adopted. Hyman’s negative source observation is not a new exhaustive search, and no discipleship is independently admitted.
